preflight_v11_diagnostic.role: non-inferential implementation, evidence and safety preflight
preflight_v11_diagnostic.finding: After a northbound turn, Cameras D and E continued returning full robot boxes but the online hull gate rejected them against the drifted point-estimate yaw. Correct Camera-E geometry passed the unchanged hull criteria at an interior yaw supported by the belief covariance. The resulting correction lockout allowed belief drift and a correct geometry safe-stop.
preflight_v11_diagnostic.journal_finding: SIGINT interrupted detector-journal fsync. The record write caught KeyboardInterrupt as a storage failure and poisoned the writer, preventing the terminal session_stopped record.

runtime_adapter_amendment.rule: Try the point-estimate yaw first. Only a refusal consisting exclusively of width/height mismatch may search 41 yaw samples inside the belief's two-sided 90-percent marginal interval. The same Stage-06 gate applies at every sample; a shape optimum on an interval boundary is refused. The selected nuisance yaw is used only for the position measurement and frozen Stage-07 features and never updates heading.
runtime_adapter_amendment.data_boundary: The final audit was already accessed and is not independent validation for the amended adapter. V4 selection and checking used commissioning_fit only; V12 is a non-inferential end-to-end preflight.

journal_shutdown_amendment.rule: On the main thread, block SIGINT/SIGTERM during write, fsync and in-memory hash-chain commit; restore the signal mask only after the durable transaction. A pending shutdown may then proceed without falsely poisoning the journal.

preflight_release_gate.reference_alignment: own-time bounded interpolation of logged ground truth with max_reference_gap_s=0.15; highest explicit anchor revision per belief state timestamp
required: bootstrap evidence records one admitted camera plus declared start prior
goal reached without collision, timeout, stuck stop or integrity failure
ground-truth final goal distance at most 0.35 m
detector and manager journals end in verified session_stopped
manifest binds V4 nuisance-yaw constants, heading method, noise and bootstrap policy
terminal stop and producer quiescence verified
preflight_release_gate.failure_policy: Do not launch the final campaign unless every gate passes. Preserve failure and freeze another amendment before retrying.

prohibitions: Do not use any preflight as navigation comparison evidence.
Do not lower detector, image-border, hull, NIS or Stage-08 route-support thresholds.
Do not re-anchor from a single fused event.
Do not use ground truth online.
Do not edit the V12 or final V9 configs after this protocol is frozen.
